_meta.purpose: 第三方插件斜杠命令简介汉化表（运行时覆盖，不修改任何插件源码）
_meta.policy: 命令名与参数原名严格保留英文，仅汉化 / 补全面板第二列的简介正文；来源标签 [u:npm:xxx] 原样保留
_meta.maintenance: 插件升级后先跑 python3 scripts/scan_plugin_commands.py --check 看差异，汉化新条目或跑 --update-baseline 刷新 en 原文基线

btw.en: Ask a quick side question without adding it to the main conversation
btw.zh: 快速提出旁支问题（不加入主对话上下文）

todos.en: Show all todos on the current branch, grouped by status
todos.zh: 查看当前分支的全部待办（按状态分组）

cc-safety-net.en: Operate CC Safety Net: explain blocks, rules, integrations, diagnostics
cc-safety-net.zh: 操作 CC Safety Net：拦截说明、规则、集成与诊断

ccstyle.en: Configure Claude Code style and rich diff options
ccstyle.zh: 配置 Claude Code 风格与富 diff 选项

context.zh: 查看当前上下文窗口占用分布

bash-mode.en: Toggle sticky bash mode (on, off, toggle)
bash-mode.zh: 切换粘性 bash 模式（on / off / toggle）

bash-reset.zh: 重置受管的 bash 会话

cd.en: Switch the Pi session working directory
cd.zh: 切换 Pi 会话工作目录

powerline.zh: 配置 powerline 状态栏（开关、预设）

powerline-perf.en: Show or reset opt-in editor performance profiling
powerline-perf.zh: 查看或重置编辑器性能分析（需手动开启）

queue.en: Manage Powerline queued prompts and project aliases
queue.zh: 管理 Powerline 排队提示词与项目别名

reply.en: Quote a previous user or assistant message into the editor
reply.zh: 把此前的用户或助手消息引用到编辑器

stash-history.zh: 打开提示词历史选择器

vibe.zh: 设置工作提示语主题。用法: /vibe [theme|off|mode|model|generate]

pi-subagents-bridge.zh: 内部面板原生请求分发（面板桥接内部使用）

prompt-workflow.en: Run a prompt template through native pi-subagents: /prompt-workflow <name> [args]
prompt-workflow.zh: 用原生 pi-subagents 运行提示词模板：/prompt-workflow <name> [args]

run.en: Run one subagent through workflowScript: /run agent[output=file] [task] [--bg] [--fork]
run.zh: 用 workflowScript 运行单个子代理：/run agent[output=file] [task] [--bg] [--fork]

subagent-cost.en: Show parent and subagent child usage cost for this session
subagent-cost.zh: 查看本会话主代理与子代理的用量开销

subagents.en: Administer subagents: inspect metadata and update models, thinking, or prompts
subagents.zh: 管理子代理：查看元数据并更新模型、思考级别与提示词

subagents-check-profile.en: Check whether a saved profile still points to usable models
subagents-check-profile.zh: 检查已保存的配置档是否仍指向可用模型

subagents-detach.en: Detach the active foreground single-subagent run without terminating it
subagents-detach.zh: 把当前前台的单子代理运行转后台（不终止）

subagents-fleet.en: Open the live subagent fleet inspector
subagents-fleet.zh: 打开子代理实时舰队面板

subagents-generate-profiles.zh: 生成 <provider>.quota 与 <provider>.quality 子代理配置档

subagents-guide.en: Show a packaged subagents guide topic
subagents-guide.zh: 查看内置的 subagents 指南主题

subagents-inspect-rpc.en: Host integration bridge: answer an async child inspection request with a correlated widget payload (no model turn)
subagents-inspect-rpc.zh: 宿主集成桥接：用关联的组件载荷应答异步子代理解析请求（不触发模型轮次）

subagents-models.en: Show model mappings for discovered subagents
subagents-models.zh: 查看已发现子代理的模型映射

subagents-profiles.zh: 列出已保存的子代理配置档

subagents-refine.en: Generate a bounded project-local refinement overlay for one subagent
subagents-refine.zh: 为单个子代理生成项目本地的受限精调覆盖配置

subagents-refresh-provider-models.en: Refresh the cached model catalog for one provider
subagents-refresh-provider-models.zh: 刷新单个服务商的模型目录缓存

subagents-steer.en: Steer a live async subagent run with a message, or one child of it with --child <child-id>
subagents-steer.zh: 向运行中的异步子代理发送引导消息；加 --child <child-id> 可指定其子任务

subagents-stop.en: Stop a current-session async subagent run, or one child of it with /subagents-stop <run-id> <child-id>
subagents-stop.zh: 停止本会话的异步子代理运行；加 /subagents-stop <run-id> <child-id> 可停止其子任务

subagents-watchdog.en: Show or toggle the default-off subagent watchdog
subagents-watchdog.zh: 查看或切换子代理看门狗（默认关闭）
